title: EOPS
content: Extended Opportunity Programs & Services (EOPS) is a state-funded program designed to help low-income and educationally disadvantaged students gain access to and successfully complete a program of higher education. The program provides school supplies, book vouchers, EOPS grants, transit passes, gas cards, educational counseling, priority registration, and application fee waivers for CSU/UC transfers. To be eligible, applicants must demonstrate financial need under CA Promise Grant B, educational disadvantage, enrollment in 12+ units at application, completion of no more than 55 degree-applicable units, and a completed education plan. Contact: EOPS/CARE Program (559) 925-3330; Maria Gonzalez, Associate Dean of Categorical Programs (559) 925-3244, MariadelaluzGonzalez@whccd.edu; Room 270B; Hours Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm.
